## Tree class

Maker-side Merkle tree used by Midnight ratifiers.

Build a tree after offers have been created and related offers have been grouped. The tree root is what Ecrecover makers sign, Setter makers approve, and payload items later prove with per-leaf ratifier data.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class Tree
```

## Example


```ts
import { Offer, Tree } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";
import { zeroAddress } from "viem";

const offer = Offer.create({
  market: {
    chainId: 8453,
    midnight: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001000",
    loanToken: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000006000",
    collateralParams: [
      {
        token: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000007000",
        lltv: 770000000000000000n,
        liquidationCursor: 250000000000000000n,
        oracle: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000008000",
      },
    ],
    maturity: 54_000n,
    rcfThreshold: 0n,
    enterGate: zeroAddress,
    liquidatorGate: zeroAddress,
  },
  buy: true,
  maker: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000009000",
  tick: 5_000n,
  expiry: 3_600n,
  ratifier: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000004000",
  maxUnits: 100n,
});
const tree = Tree.create([offer]);
console.log(tree.root);
```

[create(params)](./midnight-sdk.tree.create.md)


</td><td>

`static`


</td><td>

Creates a tree from groups or standalone offers.

Use after `Offer.create` and optional `Group.create`<!-- -->, before `Tree.mempoolValidate`<!-- -->, `EcrecoverRatifierUtils.ratify`<!-- -->, or `SetterRatifierUtils.ratify`<!-- -->. Groups are flattened, and every standalone offer is normalized as a singleton group using the router-compatible group id algorithm.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[from(tree)](./midnight-sdk.tree.from.md)


</td><td>

`static`


</td><td>

Returns a tree instance from class or plain input.

Use at boundaries that accept either a prebuilt tree or raw group/offer inputs, such as API validation helpers. Existing `Tree` instances are returned as-is.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[mempoolValidate(params)](./midnight-sdk.tree.mempoolvalidate.md)


</td><td>


</td><td>

Validates this tree against Midnight mempool API policy.

This is an API-backed convenience: by default it encodes each tree leaf with empty `ratifierData`<!-- -->, then sends the temporary payload to the Midnight API `POST /mempool/validate` endpoint. Pass `ratification` after signing or Setter root preparation to validate final payload bytes with real `ratifierData`<!-- -->.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[proof(leafIndex)](./midnight-sdk.tree.proof.md)


</td><td>


</td><td>

Builds a Merkle proof for one leaf.

Ratifier utilities call this when building per-offer `ratifierData`<!-- -->. Use it directly only for custom ratifiers or local proof inspection.


</td></tr>
